== Missing data ==
* Star Wars CCG Palace installers were served from ftp.decipher.com; no copy is known to survive (see [[Talk:Decipher.com]]).
* DecipherCon 2000 SWCCG finals 80 kb stream is lost; the 20 kb stream survives (same file as YouTube Q0sFxQ2i3Hk).
* Young Jedi foil movies for Mawhonic's Podracer and Teemto Pagalies' Podracer have only 404 captures.
* CDX 503 this sitting on youngjedi-20.rm and startrek-80.rm. Recovered: youngjedi-80.rm (28:01, 320×240) and startrek-20.rm (47:25, 160×120). Local MP4s under <code>~/.grok/swccg-video-archive/dcon2000-finals/</code>.
